content.user_title: Check Story Consistency and Plot Continuity
content.value_statement: Long manuscripts can hide timeline errors, unresolved threads, and point-of-view slips. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through structured continuity analysis and clear revision priorities.
actual_capabilities: Builds timeline, character action, plot thread, and world-rule trackers from provided story material.
Flags timeline, character, plot-hole, world-building, POV, and pacing issues.
Produces consistency reports with issue severity, locations, evidence, impact, and suggested fixes.
Creates timeline visualizations and chapter-level pacing breakdowns when enough detail is available.
Lists unresolved plot threads and priority fixes for author revision.
limitations: Requires the user to provide story text, synopsis, character lists, or world rules.
Cannot verify continuity outside the material supplied in the conversation.
May miss intentional ambiguity unless the author labels it clearly.
Does not replace editorial judgment or genre-specific story coaching.

use_cases.title: Audit a Draft
use_cases.description: Review multiple chapters for timeline breaks, character contradictions, and unresolved plot threads before beta reading.

use_cases.title: Check POV Rules
use_cases.description: Find knowledge leaks, head-hopping, and narrator access problems in first-person or limited third-person scenes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Revision Notes
use_cases.description: Create an actionable continuity report with evidence, impact, and top revision priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Continuity Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small chapter set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check these chapters for plot consistency. Focus on timeline order, character actions, and unresolved threads. Give me the top issues first.

prompt_templates.title: Timeline and Pacing Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review for chronology and story rhythm.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this synopsis and chapter list for timeline errors and pacing problems. Include issue severity, evidence, impact, and suggested fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Full Story Consistency Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with story bible details.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the plot consistency checker process on my draft. I will provide the synopsis, character list, world rules, timeline, and chapters.

prompt_templates.title: Revision Priority Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced follow-up after a previous analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this revised draft against the prior consistency report. Identify fixed issues, remaining contradictions, and the next five revision priorities.

output_examples.input: Five fantasy chapters where a character travels between cities overnight.
output: Critical issue: Travel time conflicts with the established five-day distance.
Evidence should cite the departure, camp scene, and arrival scene.
Suggested fix: Add a time skip, establish faster travel, or revise the distance.

output_examples.input: A first-person romance scene where the narrator describes private thoughts of another character.
output: POV issue: The narrator knows details they did not observe or learn.
Impact: Readers may feel the scene breaks the declared viewpoint.
Suggested fix: Replace certainty with observable behavior and narrator inference.

output_examples.input: A draft with many unresolved clues and uneven chapter tension.
output: Moderate issue: Several plot threads are introduced but not revisited.
Pacing note: Major reveals feel rushed compared with low-conflict chapters.
Priority fix: Decide which clues need payoff, removal, or delayed resolution.

best_practices: Provide chapters, synopsis, character list, timeline, and world rules together when possible.
Tell the assistant which contradictions are intentional mysteries or unreliable narration.
Ask for priority fixes before requesting line-level rewrites.
anti_patterns: Submitting isolated scenes without context and expecting full continuity coverage.
Asking for only praise when the goal is to find structural problems.
Treating every flagged issue as an error before checking author intent.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks timelines, character actions, plot holes, world rules, POV consistency, unresolved threads, and pacing.

faq.question: Do I need to provide the full manuscript?
faq.answer: No. You can provide selected chapters, but broader context improves continuity analysis.

faq.question: Can it help with intentional contradictions?
faq.answer: Yes. Label intentional mysteries, unreliable narration, dreams, or time loops before the review.

faq.question: Does it rewrite my story?
faq.answer: It focuses on diagnosis and suggested fixes. You can ask for rewrites after reviewing the findings.

faq.question: Can it create a story bible?
faq.answer: It can help build continuity trackers for characters, timelines, rules, and plot threads.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
